David likes cloudy days best. The weekend breakfast is one of the best places in the city. David thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. The puppy looked adorable curled up in a blanket.
David usually has chicken for breakfast. Last Tuesday, David and Ben went to the weekend breakfast. Both of them like chicken and tea. Wild flowers covered the hillside.
David hopes to visit Paris one day. David learned a lot about music. The weather was cloudy that day. Best of all, the sailors left the sinking ship in small boats.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the weekend breakfast by bike. David is going to travel to Paris in March. David wrote about the day in the diary.
